text: Only four people knew of the convent's forbidden library: Anka, Leonica, Mother Superior Bernice, and caretaker Anel.
Among the recovered forbidden books was one titled Sancti Mihi Histori Vera, written in invisible ink, revealing that Saint Mihi actually fought the Vrakieri rather than dragons as commonly believed.
A post-credits scene reveals Cohen survives into the modern day, still fighting supernatural forces as Anahora's corruption begins seeping into the real world again.
